name: McKinsey & Company
one_liner: The largest of the MBB firms, known for top-management strategy work, a one-firm global partnership, and a highly structured, interviewer-led recruiting process.
at_a_glance: Roughly 38,000+ employees across 130+ cities in 65+ countries.
Employee-owned private firm run as a single global partnership.
Alumni network of 50,000+ former colleagues, prominent in senior corporate roles.
Known research and capability arms include the McKinsey Global Institute and QuantumBlack (AI).

rounds: Screen: online Solve assessment for most consultant applicants.
First round: ~2 interviews, each combining a Personal Experience Interview story and a problem-solving case.
Final round: ~2-3 interviews with partners, same PEI + case structure, often with deeper PEI probing.
interview_process.case_style: Interviewer-led problem-solving interview: the interviewer asks a sequence of questions (structure, exhibit reading, math, creative brainstorm, synthesis) rather than you steering.
interview_process.fit_style: Personal Experience Interview (PEI): one deep story per interview, probed in detail. McKinsey names four qualities: personal impact, entrepreneurial drive, inclusive leadership and courageous change.
interview_process.assessments: Solve, a gamified digital problem-solving assessment; McKinsey says no specific preparation is needed. Length is stated in your invitation.

what_they_look_for: Personal impact: influencing people and outcomes
Entrepreneurial drive: ambitious goals, persistence through obstacles
Inclusive leadership: bringing diverse people together
culture: Strong 'obligation to dissent' norm: juniors are expected to voice disagreement.
'One firm' model: offices share one global P&L and staffing is fluid across geographies.
Heavy investment in formal training and feedback; apprenticeship culture on teams.
why_us_angles: Which McKinsey Global Institute or QuantumBlack work connects to problems you care about, and why?
How does the one-firm, globally staffed model fit any interest you have in cross-border work?
Which of your PEI-style stories shows impact you would want to scale at McKinsey?
Which McKinsey practice or industry group matches your industry background?
prep_tips: Build 4+ PEI stories with rich detail: your specific actions, others' reactions, obstacles, and measurable result.
Practice interviewer-led cases: answer only the question asked, then pause for the next prompt.
Drill fast exhibit reading and clean mental math, stating the 'so what' after every number.
Prepare for a creative brainstorm question: generate a structured, MECE list quickly.
Take Solve seriously but calmly; follow tutorials and manage time within each task.
Practice McKinsey's public sample cases (e.g., Beautify, Diconsa) to calibrate the format.
